entities.summary: Michalis Chrisochoidis is a Greek politician and member of the Hellenic Parliament for the Athens B2 constituency with New Democracy. He currently serves as Minister for Citizen Protection in the Second Cabinet of Kyriakos Mitsotakis. He had served in the same role on four occasions, as a member of PASOK and an independent politician. He has also served as Minister for the Economy, Competitiveness and Shipping (2010), Minister for Regional Development and Competitiveness (2010–2011), Minister for Development, Competitiveness and Shipping (2011–2012), Minister for Infrastructure, Transport and Networks (2013–2015) and Minister for Health (2023–2024).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As Minister for Health from 2023 to 2024, Michalis Chrisochoidis played a key role in shaping Greece's healthcare policy and response to the COVID-19 pandemic. His tenure had significant regional impact on the country's public health infrastructure.
